verses.gurmukhi: ਦੀਪਕ ਜਲੈ ਪਤੰਗ ਵੰਸੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਹਟੈ।
verses.translit_en: dheepak jalai pata(n)g va(n)s fir dhekh na haTai|

en.bdb: Seeing the burning flame of the lamp the moths cannot withhold themselves.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਫੜਿ ਕਢੀਐ ਮਛ ਨੇਹੁ ਨ ਘਟੈ।
verses.translit_en: jal vichahu faR kaddeeaai machh neh na ghaTai|

en.bdb: The fish is taken out of water but still it does not give up its love for water.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘੰਡਾ ਹੇੜੈ ਮਿਰਗ ਜਿਉ ਸੁਣਿ ਨਾਦੁ ਪਲਟੈ।
verses.translit_en: gha(n)ddaa heRai mirag jiau sun naadh palaTai|

en.bdb: As listening to the drum beat of the hunter, the deer turns towards the sound,

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਵਰੈ ਵਾਸੁ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਫੜਿ ਕਵਲੁ ਸੰਘਟੈ।
verses.translit_en: bhavarai vaas vinaas hai faR kaval sa(n)ghaTai|

en.bdb: And the black bee by entering the flower perishes itself for enjoying the fragrance.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ ਬਹੁ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਟੈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal piram ras bahu ba(n)dhan kaTai|

en.bdb: Similarly, the gurmukhs enjoy the delight of love and liberate themselves from all the bondages.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਿੱਖ ਵੰਸੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਖਟੈ ॥੨੩॥੨੭॥
verses.translit_en: dha(n)n dha(n)n gursi'kh va(n)s dha(n)n gurmat nidh khaTai ||23||27||

en.bdb: The family lineage of theGuru and the Sikhs is blessed who following the wisdom of Guru realize the self.
